reason: Adds a targeted API-version deprecation and a bounded data migration with a version check; it changes how existing source pins are handled, not just documentation.
Only changes the displayed release status from alpha to GA. The patch does not establish that functionality or adoption changed.
Tightens one host-field validation path and tests malformed input. This is a useful but localised correction.
Distinguishes credit exhaustion and transient X lookup failures with matching tests. The changed path is one provider's validation messaging.
Classifies a deterministic 422 as non-retryable and tests that it stops retrying. The effect is limited to this provider's error path.
Includes SQLSTATE codes in CDC error telemetry and tests capture. It aids diagnosis but does not itself resolve the underlying failure.
Adds support for a second vendor API version, caps version-specific page sizes and tests pinned/default version requests. This is a bounded functional capability.
Routes missing IAM permission errors to actionable configuration failures across dataset and publish paths with a targeted test; changes retry behaviour of a destination pipeline.
Adds a narrow deleted-dataset error signature to avoid repeated retries. The regression test covers the local mapping.
Skips vanished webhook files after concurrent consumption without dropping other files, and tests continuation and cleanup. This changes the shared ingestion path's race handling.
Normalises BigQuery legacy type names for schema-evolution DDL and exercises later-batch float columns against a stricter fake. A bounded data-correctness repair.
Classifies file-descriptor exhaustion as a transient maintenance failure and checks unrelated OSErrors stay unchanged. Narrow error-classification fix.
Adds validated daily usage to billing limit updates behind a flag with enabled/disabled tests. This is bounded new billing behaviour, not a demonstrated customer outcome.
Adds OpenTelemetry timing for database-build phases and tests emitted phases. This improves observability but does not itself speed up queries.

Changes repository selection in channel mode from reusing local checkouts to task-specific clones and updates isolation tests. It changes agent execution policy; prompts inside the diff are data, not review instructions.
Allows gzip for two task-run log endpoints with tests that exclude streaming paths. A narrow response-configuration change.
Pins Docker Compose project naming across CI steps by setting a project name and exporting it to later steps. A local CI consistency fix.
Adds the same timestamp minmax index to metrics2 schema/config across environments. Repetition in generated SQL is not extra credit; query benefit is unmeasured.

Moves stylesheet and font host restrictions from a report-only shadow into the enforced application CSP across cloud pages, with tests for the host set and removal of the shadow. This is concrete shared security-policy hardening, not evidence of attacks prevented.
Adds a provisioned-server prerequisite to registration under a feature flag and tests both states. Prevents a concrete setup failure in this workflow.

Centralises timezone-aware date tick and tooltip inference in shared charts and migrates several consumers; DST and chart tests cover behaviour. Broad reuse, but still a bounded formatting correction.
Makes toast titles and descriptions selectable without triggering swipe dismissal. A small but concrete shared UI correction; repeated desktop CSS is not additional credit.

Adds a new index and autovacuum tuning for a high-volume table, adjusts absorbed-row query filtering and fixes shared multi-database migration routing with tests. This is systemic database-path work; performance gains are not independently measured.
Carries safe replacement text from HogQL resolution to editor notices, guards against replacing an entire query and tests both suggestions and unsafe chains. A bounded user-facing capability.

Makes previously environment-gated Slack scopes available in the common integration path and updates the schema/types. This is a bounded permission-capability change; external approval claimed in comments is not independently checked.
Schedules meeting rematches after account matching inputs expand and adds candidate matching across participants. This changes account-meeting association behaviour across API and background work.
Adds a gated, admin-restricted setting for a default flag-cleanup repository and persists edits through existing configuration logic. A bounded settings capability.
Adds a feature- and access-gated link from service logs to metrics while carrying the selected time window, with a routing regression test. A bounded cross-product navigation feature.

Adds codec-aware S3/Azure reads and guards ambiguous patterns across schema discovery and count paths, with format and URL-pattern tests. It changes a shared data correctness path, not just a file-size proxy.
Replaces wildcard OAuth requests with an explicit scope list and structural guards. List length is not impact; external server-side ceiling and real login safety are not established by this diff.

Distinguishes live persons from tombstones before splitting a distinct ID, avoiding reuse of a live UUID and changing SQL selection with storage tests. This protects a core person-identity correctness path; observed production impact is unknown.

Adds permission-checked admin controls to inspect, start and mark experiment metric recalculations terminal, with a guard against overwriting completed runs. A bounded operational capability, not evidence of recovered outcomes.

Persists reasons that block incremental sync after a key failure, exposes them through API/frontend and guides recovery while preventing blind reenabling. A cross-layer correctness and recovery change; no usage result is verified.

Routes command replies through ephemeral Slack messages and preserves top-level/thread placement, with tests that reject public channel posts. Bounded privacy and UX behaviour, not a measured user outcome.

Converts supported array elements during materialised-view Arrow export rather than skipping all array conversions, with tests for UUID, IP, datetime and unsupported nested shapes. Bounded data-format correctness.
Carries unsaved insight query edits into the edit URL with regression tests. A local navigation state-loss fix, regardless of the number of tests added.
Adds an opt-in admin-log source table with pagination and incremental merge handling, plus endpoint tests. Functional data-source coverage; actual vendor response and adoption are unverified.

Adds workflow-webhook idempotency reservations across the queue boundary, with tests for duplicates, concurrent requests, failed queueing and key limits. Protects a shared invocation path against duplicate execution.

Formats embedded object and file mentions in task-feed previews instead of exposing raw markup, with cases for truncated tags; includes a small hover-style correction. A bounded UI usability improvement.
Adds user controls for pie-slice names and value/percentage combinations through insight options and shared chart rendering, with tests. Bounded visualisation capability, not measured usage.

Builds worker assets into Storybook's static path and preserves decompression fallback when a worker fails, including buffer ownership. Meaningful reliability work across build and playback paths, but no measured outcome.
Introduces a persisted compact/comfortable sidebar-density choice and adapts navigation styling and schema with tests. A bounded user-facing customisation feature.

Differentiates invalid keys, missing permissions and transient probe errors in two providers with tests. These are separate provider changes grouped by repeated title; verify whether they should share a group before attribution.
